brief:
Israeli occupation forces invaded the village of Aqraba, south of Nablus in the northern occupied West Bank, early Tuesday morning and surrounded a residential home, according to IMEMC News. Soldiers then attacked the house in what witnesses described as a siege operation. During the assault, troops killed a Palestinian man and subsequently removed his body from the scene.

The Palestinian Health Ministry identified the slain man, though his name and further biographical details remained unclear in immediate reports. The operation marked the latest in a series of Israeli military raids across Palestinian communities in the West Bank.

title: Israeli army kills Palestinian during home siege near Nablus
